future_divergences.summary: Python 3.13 adds the Py_mod_gil module slot and its stable-ABI constants.
During interpreter finalization, Python 3.14 hangs the calling thread instead of terminating it.
Free-threaded 3.13 builds add refcount and immortality behavior that must be accessed through public refcount APIs, not private header bits.
Private _Py APIs may change without notice and several were removed or restored during the 3.13 cycle.
